mapper.sql: id, username, user_no, password, salt, status, real_name, email, avatar, sex, birthday, phone, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, del_flag
mapper.select: select b.role_code, b.role_name, b.id from sys_user_role a left join sys_role b on a.role_id = b.id where a.user_id = #{id}
select b.dept_name, b.dept_name_en, b.dept_name_abbr, b.id from sys_user_dept a left join sys_dept b on a.dept_id = b.id where a.user_id = #{id}
